name: capture
$tagsComment: Phase 8's phone capture page (docs/business-apps/development-plan.md): photos taken on a phone, filed on a record where its layout's capture says (layout-v2.md, section 2). A feature: it reads the layout through libs/shared/document-layouts and uploads through libs/shared/nuxeo-client, and nothing depends on it but the app.
